sloka: शशमालक्ष्य सिंहो वा पन्नगं गरुडो यथा ।न चिन्तयति तं वाली रावणं पापनिश्चयम् ।। ७.३४.१५ ॥
transliteration: śaśamālakṣya siṁho vā pannagaṁ garuḍo yathā ।na cintayati taṁ vālī rāvaṇaṁ pāpaniścayam ।। 7.34.15 ॥

translations.english: Just as a lion does not worry about a rabbit, or Garuda about a serpent, so Valin did not consider that evil-minded Ravana a threat.
